Description: rev.ng is a static binary analysis framework based on LLVM and QEMU. Key features: * Full-fledged decompiler, that emits syntactically valid C. * Large architecture support (x86-64 x86, ARM, AArch64, MIPS and s390x). * Ideal environment for deobufscation thanks to the off-the-shelf availability of the LLVM -O2 optimization pipeline. * Support for static code analysis using symbolic execution (KLEE or clang-static-analyzer) or CodeQL. * Automatic recovery of data structures exploiting information across the whole program. * Scripting interface for Python and TypeScript.
